context.transcript:
Welcome to our twenty-fifth annual software development
conference. We have an exciting agenda prepared for you,
including three keynote speeches. Our first speaker,
Rodrigo Flores, is the creator of the mobile phone application
Pocket Me, which currently has over a million users. And it
was launched six months ago! You can find where he'll be
giving his speech in our online program. Remember that
for the first time, this year the conference is paper-free-use
any of the QR codes available to access the schedule.
context.transcript_translation: 欢迎参加我们的第二十五届年度软件开发大会。我们为大家准备了精彩的议程，其中包括三场主题演讲。第一位演讲者罗德里戈·弗洛雷斯是手机应用 Pocket Me 的开发者，该应用目前已有一百多万名用户。而它仅在六个月前才发布！大家可以在我们的在线议程中查到他的演讲地点。请记住，今年大会首次实行无纸化，请使用现场提供的任意二维码查看日程。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“科技会议”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
